discussion_title: Accepting PEP 572, Assignment Expressions (mailing-list thread only)

evidence.quote: As anticippated, after a final round of feedback I am hereby accepting PEP 572, Assignment Expressions.
evidence.author: Guido van Rossum

outcome_evidence.quote: As anticippated, after a final round of feedback I am hereby accepting PEP 572, Assignment Expressions.
outcome_evidence.author: Guido van Rossum

decisions.proposal: Allow assignment to attributes and subscripts in assignment expressions
decisions.reason: Not enough use cases; Potential reduction in code clarity

evidence.quote: Why does this not allow assignment to attributes and subscripts?
evidence.author: Random832

evidence.quote: there weren't enough use-cases for attribute/item assignment to justify creating a rule of "you can assign to any single target, but can't unpack"
evidence.author: Chris Angelico

evidence.quote: Also nobody had a use case.
evidence.author: Guido van Rossum

evidence.quote: there isn't a technical limitation preventing it, there's a design decision that we currently believe allowing it would reduce code clarity rather than increase it
evidence.author: Nick Coghlan
